outcome: early newborn intensive care unit (NICU) need
cohort: 230 mothers and their newborns from India.
finding: Gestational weight gain and pre-pregnancy BMI showed a positive linear connection with birth weight, and were identified as factors determining birth weight, gestational age, and newborn morbidities.
mod_finding: Higher pre-pregnancy BMI (overweight) and excess gestational weight gain were linked to a higher rate of caesarean section.
